title: Post-convergence infrastructure compression

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
User-approved 30-slice proposal with exact scope, verification tiers, stop conditions, deferrals, preservation boundary, and done contract.

allowedWork: Project-control documentation and generated project counts.
Reproducible architecture, reachability, inference, bundle, and iteration-economics measurements.
Typed equation-authoring requests, repair diagnostics, one narrow compile facade, and a tool-neutral direct-import adapter over existing authority.
Immutable family, capability, and loader declarations with literal dynamic imports and exhaustive validated projections.
Behavior-preserving ownership extraction from equation-surface-adapter and symbolic-manipulation-family-registry.
Adjacent retirement only after exact last-caller reachability and stronger invariant ownership are proved.
disallowedWork: Visual timing, geometry, choreography, salience, layout, typography, animation-content redesign, or promotion of the pending log-product candidate.
Protected economics source/publication, unrelated dirty files, package installation, directory-wide moves, formatting churn, or blanket test deletion.
Live LLM runtime, arbitrary model-authored code, universal plugin or domain compiler, new clock, new renderer authority, mutable global registry, or broad Graph3D/public-product work.
STOP on human visual judgment, semantic or endpoint drift, deterministic runtime drift, bundle regression, ambiguous deletion, circular ownership, weaker type safety, or scope expansion.
goal: Reconcile durable truth, prove the governed equation authoring path, retire only reachable redundancy, open capability loading through typed declarations, clarify high-churn ownership, and reduce measured compiler and verification cost without visual or semantic change.

slices.title: control-plane-truth
slices.summary: Reconciled roadmap and active threads: the 26-slice narrow-core run is complete, the infrastructure-compression contract is active, and the pending log-product visual remains outside this run.

slices.title: derived-inventory-truth
slices.summary: Added one deterministic projection of canonical catalogue, equation disposition, selected capability, and compatibility truth; active prose now cites 45 loadable assets, 30 equation surfaces, 10 selected capabilities, and 6 compatibility entries without maintaining parallel totals.

slices.title: durable-deferral-register
slices.summary: Recorded nine non-executable deferral classes with durable owners, explicit revisit triggers, and reasons, including visual policy, product/layout, SvelteKit, HTML encoding, compatibility, renderer expansion, live-model evaluation, physical moves, and broad test migration.

slices.title: post-refactor-baseline
slices.summary: Captured reproducible post-refactor iteration, bundle, compiler, verification, compatibility, command-surface, and high-churn ownership baselines. Recorded two known red gates: inference Types budget 57,283 > 50,000 and a stale hard-coded 25-vs-30 equation count; both have approved repair slices and neither reflects semantic loss.

slices.title: inference-attribution
slices.summary: Added a stable per-fixture inference attribution command. Proved 27,947 of 57,283 Types arise from the empty standard-library baseline; broad barrels add avoidable closure, while operation-evaluation and factoring are the largest direct generic closures. No type or budget changed.

slices.title: verification-tiers
slices.summary: Added named equation verification tiers: inner, boundary, promotion, and release. Inner runs preservation plus extension dispatch in roughly five seconds; selector and CLI tests plus architecture checks pass.

slices.title: generation-pressure-contract
slices.summary: Added three strict LLM-shaped pressure fixtures for function wrap, cancellation, and distribution/factoring. Each names governed semantic vocabulary, demands zero-repair first-pass acceptance, records validator-round repairs, and forbids caller-authored presentation fields.

slices.title: function-wrap-trial
slices.summary: Ran the function-wrap fixture through current authority. Catalogue validation passed, canonical entity closure required one repair because entity IDs are not exposed, and the repaired request reached the existing extension pack and compiled motif with native endpoints, deterministic seek/rewind, and no generic fallback.

slices.title: cancellation-trial
slices.summary: Ran the cancellation fixture through current authority. One semantic-ID repair was required; the repaired request selected only the authored inverse pair, protected the equal right-side glyph, reached compiler-generated witnessed annihilation, and preserved deterministic endpoints and rewind without fallback.

slices.title: distribution-factoring-trial
slices.summary: Ran the distribution/factoring fixture through current authority. One semantic-ID repair was required; the repaired request preserved one-to-two factor cardinality, derived-copy identity, product topology, inverse factoring, endpoints, and rewind. The trial proved that the facade must derive canonical role complements rather than solicit or ignore them.

slices.title: generation-gap-synthesis
slices.summary: Classified the shared generation failure as a typed repair gap caused by omitted surface entity vocabulary. Added one reusable entity.unresolved diagnostic, removed three ad hoc closure checks, and authorized only a narrow facade that resolves canonical IDs and derives already-owned complements without adding motifs or presentation authority.

slices.title: compile-equation-intent-facade
slices.summary: Added the narrow compileEquationIntent facade and surface-vocabulary projection for the three pressure cases. It returns existing compiler-minted motif, semantic-motion, or operation plans; rejects unresolved entities, operation mismatches, and wrong ownership; has positive/negative type proof; and owns no timing, geometry, renderer, or fallback authority.

slices.title: tool-neutral-request-adapter
slices.summary: Added the tool-neutral equation-intent command. It lists canonical vocabularies, reads JSON from stdin or a file, returns compact accepted authority summaries or stable typed repairs, uses exit 0/2 predictably, and its runtime import closure excludes editor, Svelte, rendering, DOM, and browser modules.
